snippet.title: Romestead | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
"Clock in at the only convenience store in the liminal void between life and death. Juggle supernatural customer service, collapsing inventory, and unravel the truth behind your own damnation.

As an overworked clerk stuck in a literal dead-end job you'll have to deal with the unpredictable threats of the dead and manage your stock in order to pay your debt to the faceless management."
